models.name: samurai
models.description: A Japanese samurai kneeling in seiza (sitting on his heels), full body, facing forward, hands resting flat on his thighs. Black lacquered lamellar armor (do cuirass) laced with red silk cords, black shoulder guards (sode) with red lacing, dark indigo hakama trousers folded under his knees. Kabuto helmet in black lacquer with a large golden crescent crest (kuwagata) on the front, flared neck guard. Dark red menpo half-mask covering mouth and chin, eyes visible. A katana in a black scabbard lying on the floor in front of his knees. Compact, solid pose, detailed armor plates.

models.name: sakura
models.description: A single Japanese cherry blossom tree (sakura), whole tree, isolated, no ground and no grass. Thick twisted dark brown trunk splitting into several strong branches, a very wide, dense, rounded umbrella-shaped canopy of deep saturated magenta-pink blossom clumps, solid and full, with a few drooping branches at the edges. Stylized 3D game asset, clean silhouette.

models.name: samurai_fighter
models.description: A Japanese samurai standing in a combat stance, full body, side-on, legs wide apart and knees bent, both hands gripping a long katana raised above his head ready to strike. Black lacquered armor laced with red cords, black shoulder guards, dark indigo hakama trousers, kabuto helmet with a golden crescent crest, dark red face mask. Dynamic, solid silhouette, stylized 3D game asset.
